div.div: Why SWIM and not heartbeats to a central registry? A registry is another thing that must be reachable across the WAN. SWIM keeps working inside a partitioned substation and spreads load evenly (IN5020: failure detectors, P2P).

SWIM keeps working inside a partitioned substation and spreads load evenly (IN5020: failure detectors, P2P).
